set.body:
One reusable function loads the admitted Sherlock record (docs/data/sherlock/timebase-repair.json, committed), parses it, builds the ClockRepairs and the MediaManifest, and hands them to SherlockAnnotations.parse. Every entry point calls it. Today that is sherlockRecallMap (SherlockRecallMapping.scala:233), which calls parse(bytes) with the literal default.

Deliberately a function rather than an edit to sherlockRecallMap: the recall-map command (bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM) will replace it, and the loader must outlive it.

Decide the fate of parse's default argument `manifest = MediaManifest.nn2017` (SherlockAnnotations.scala:269). A default that silently selects the literal path is how production came to bypass the record. Removing it forces every caller through the loader.
set.title: C1: one reusable loader for the admitted Sherlock record, called by every entry point
